description: This PHP source file defines an API endpoint class `TimeConfigPeriodAPI` in the namespace `OrangeHRM	ime\Api`. It provides REST API methods for retrieving and updating the configuration of a timesheet period in the OrangeHRM system, including validation rules, method handlers (getOne, update), and related service interactions. The class manages the start day parameter for the timesheet period and ensures proper enabling of related menu items upon updates.

classes.name: TimeConfigPeriodAPI
classes.description: Defines REST API endpoints for fetching and updating the timesheet period configuration in the OrangeHRM system, handling parameter validation, service integration, and response formatting.

methods.name: getTimesheetPeriodService
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the TimesheetPeriodService instance used for timesheet period operations.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve current timesheet period configuration, returns the start day.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the GET request, excluding the ID parameter.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update the timesheet period start day, enables related menu items upon success, and returns updated configuration.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the update request, ensuring the timesheet period is not already defined and validating the startDay parameter.
